description: Azure RBAC User Access Administrator - can grant any Azure RBAC role (incl. Owner) on any resource scope.

telemetry.detail: Privileged Azure RBAC role assignment can be flagged by anomaly policies.
Microsoft Defender for Cloud (Defender for Resource Manager) flags suspicious/anomalous privileged RBAC role assignments; requires the paid plan.

prerequisite_privilege: User Access Administrator (or Owner) on the target scope
abuse_primitive: Grant yourself Owner/Contributor on a subscription/resource-group, then act on resources.
notes: Role assignments write to the Azure Activity log (default-on); alerting depends on Defender for Cloud / Sentinel.
